description.narrative:
The Enhanced Danish-Ethiopian Energy Partnership (DEEP) is a government-to-government energy partnership programme with a budget of DKK 60 million of Danish grant funds for technical assistance and capacity development focused on energy planning and modelling, wind power development, and integration of variable renewable energy.
In order to support the Ethiopian Government in this transition, DEEP will focus on the following areas: - Creating choice awareness in the energy sector development, through long-term planning and modelling - Promoting and creating and enabling environment and transparent framework for lowering the cost of wind power development - Integration of variable renewable energy by best practise TSO and DSO operation and by dynamic interaction with power systems in neighbouring countries. Denmark’s Strategy for Development Cooperation and Humanitarian Action

To support the development of the Ethiopian government structures and systems that in a sustainable and cost effective way to ensure access to affordable, reliable, sustainable and modern energy for all (SDG 7) and hereby supporting the Ethiopian vision of building a Climate Resilient Green Economy while reaching lower middle-income status by 2025. To support the expected increase in supply to accommodate energy demand by enabling an environment for investment, cost-efficient electricity system planning to increase security of supply.
